transcript.text: Hello and welcome to On Print Shop.
In this video, we'll be talking about an exciting feature called mass personalization.
Mass template personalization is a feature that allows users to customize templates in bulk.
This feature enables users to personalize multiple templates at once, saving time and effort.
With mass personalization, users can easily add personalized text, images, and other elements to templates, making them unique and tailored to individual needs.
This feature is particularly useful for businesses that require customized templates for their customers, such as printing companies or marketing agencies.
For personalization, The customers can add their data either by uploading an XLS file or by using a Form Fill option.
For users who are not familiar with XML files.
The Form Fill option provides a user friendly interface that simplifies the data entry experience and streamlines data input for both methods.
So let's get started with the admin panel.
First, go to the Products and click on Settings in the General tab.
In the Mass Personalization setting, simply click on the drop down menu and you will have the option to choose between uploading an Excel file, manual data, or both.
Selecting the Upload Excel file means that customers will only be able to upload an Excel file with their data.
Whereas choosing manual data means customers will only have the option to manually enter their data using available fields.
And if you select both customers will be able to choose either method then we have the default option to select.
This means that if admin selects upload excel file then this option will be preselected for users on the front store.
Similarly, if we pick manual data, the option Manual data will be preselected.
Next, if you want to allow mass personalization for image elements too, just enable this option and the customers will be allowed to personalize images in the mass template personalization.
When you have disabled this, then there will be no option for the users to upload any images on the front end.
Now let's see how these settings enhance the customer experience on the front end of the product's additional information page.
So we are on the additional information page of the standard business card product.
On this page, the customers will have the option if they want to proceed with mass personalization.
On the selection of Yes, the mass template personalization button will appear in the pop up.
The customers will have personalization options.
Upload XLS, fill form data or both as per your configuration.
The XLS file option is tailored for large scale products.
If a customer prefers to use an Excel file, they can choose that option by selecting Upload XLS from the radio button.
They will be prompted to upload their file directly.
With the XLS file option, you can simply download, fill in details, upload, and summarize vast amounts of data effortlessly.
Let's take an example.
As a customer, you can simply fill up data in the downloaded XLS file and browse the computer for the desired XLS file.
Also, you can upload images in zip format and make bulk upload with just a few clicks.
Now click on the Continue button and once you go to the Mass Personalization summary page, you can see records and preview samples by clicking on the Sample preview button as you can see here.
Then our system will process the data and incorporate it into their order.
But what if you have smaller scale products?
The second way of template personalization is via the Manual Data option.
This is designed specifically for products like stickers or labels, and the streamlined interface makes managing your data a breeze.
You simply need to fill in the required template form fields and you're good to go.
Your customers can even choose to exclude any field from the personalization using the Exclude from Personalization button.
Here, they can select the fields they want to skip from personalization and then continue with the desired ones.
In this case, the system will consider the default values for these skipped fields while generating PDFs.
With the Add More button at the bottom of the pop up, customers can add more rows for data entry.
Once they have uploaded the required text and images, they can first choose to preview the details.
The system will generate the files for the number of entries with the customer's data with it.
When they are sure about the details, they can click on the Continue button from the pop up.
This will redirect back to the additional info page where the customers can verify the number of records added and other files with the option to download each file.
If everything looks good to go, they can proceed with the checkout.
And that's it.
This was all about how you can configure and offer the option of template personalization in bulk to your customers.
If you have any further questions, please feel free to reach out to our support team via mail or live chat.
Thank you.

Steps to Upload Mass Template Personalization File
Mass Template Personalization means you are looking to print the same template but with a different set of data. Some products
such as business cards in a store style may require the personalization of every printed copy. You can mass personalize your design
template by simply following the steps below -
1. Download a sample file to mass personalizes your design.
2. Fill in the details required in the file. Note - Please do not change any existing content from the sample file. Also, ensure that the
number of records in your file matches the existing number of design templates.
3. After filling the file, upload it using the 'Upload File' link. Click on 'Continue' to view the total order cost.
